name.description: the level's name in the game (header +0x00)

base.description: stock:level/<n>: this is an edit of a stock level: its objects are added to the level's own list and its header fields change the stock header (the port's level patches)

fixedId.description: phase 0 only: the level id to use until the port's content linker exists

fixedObjectLists.description: phase 0 only: the object lists to replace (an unused level's) until the content linker exists

editStock.description: an edit of a stock level: its own objects may be changed and removed too (objects.json stockEdits); off, they are read-only and only added objects change it

header.description: header fields by name (decomp levels.py names); unnamed fields come from the neutral template

paths.description: animation paths: objects the level's animation block spawns and moves (paths.py)

playerBodies.description: the heroes play in another body in this level (port jfg_assets.json playerBodies): an object id per hero, e.g. the cut Tribal man 0x4 (juno) or yellow ant 0x21 (vela). Only the body changes

planet.description: a planet of the project (planets/<name>.json): the level is in that planet's region, so leaving the planet by an exit shows the game's stats screen and entering it shows its name (the port numbers the region; header region and regionIndex are set by the build)
